featured_reviews.name: Afzal Mohhamad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros: Nearest to marine lines station.That's it.

Cons: On 4th floor

Rooms size of matchboxes with costs of 3bhk.

They don't allow outside food inside the hostel, umm sorry I didn't know this was a movie theater that you are not allowing outside food.

1 unit electricity at 18Rs. Please note the reading or click a pic of the meter otherwise god help you.

Water is chargeable. Yes drinking water in a hostel is not free because it is a luxury.

Food per plate is 150rs. Guess I'll sleep empty stomach for half the month with these rates.

Staff. So professional and friendly. NOT.

FULL DISCLOSURE - I paid 15k for a 4 sharing matchbox. No meals included. No water taken by me because it is dispicable to be charged for it by the hostel. Electricity charge was 3k per person so 12k for 1 month for a room. If confused ask your papa what is the home's electrical bill for a month. You'll be surprised. That's it. This review was written for a stay 3 yr ago because I wanted to not give bad rep to the business but after reading some recent reviews and how they were mistreated I couldn't hold it for long.

featured_reviews.name: Aman Saiyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good hostel with ample facilities. Mess is also available here. The rooms here consists of 4 bed, 6bed, 9bed, and 15 beded.
The rooms are cleaned daily by the cleaners, moreover it is located at the prime location of CSMT and marine drive is also very close to it .
Security is quiet good and the passages are equipped with camera's. Admission first preference is given to the Anjuman Students and then the other institute students.though they serve only breakfast and dinner but the quality of the food is excellent. Also, 4 days in a week they serve Chicken in dinner and milk everyday. The hostel warden is quiet supportive and understanding. The rooms are WIFI enabled and has proper ventilation. The yearly fees varies from 80,000 to 1,05,000 rs. The hostel has got a big study room with proper desk and chairs open 24X7 for studies. Moreover hostel has got a mosque in the campus and a big playground. The hostel has 5 floors and has a capacity of more than 180 students.

If you’re looking for a budget friendly, safe and centrally located stay in Mumbai, Aashiyana Dormitory is a solid choice.

Lots of attitude in the way they deal. When I was trying to be a little tough to negotiate, he realised he couldn't get a deal and tried to show as if he didn't care. Not open to negotiate since "it will affect my marketing".

The idea is simple, they want to give it to vulnerable parents who would pay any price for their kid's stay, since price is not a concern for them. Definitely not for working professionals.

Since he couldn't say no, he just gave a lot of attitude. Took me to properties knowing I would reject.

And if they say "oh you didn't inform us of the budget." I wanted to understand what you have, and what budgets you offer for, before I realise it would suit me or not.

I was shown a flat initially that I liked, and one hour later they told me it was booked. They didn't tell me before that there was interest for the flat, and would be booked.

I just feel the owner has a lot of attitude in the way they deal, because of the vulnerable parents market. Some of their prices give more value elsewhere; but I've not subscribed to them, so can't say.

featured_reviews.name: Vatsalya Awasthi
featured_reviews.review_text:
So I'm a working professional who stayed in the PG from July '22 to November '22.

TLDR: The PG provides excellent value for money. They have good room rates which also cover food (3 meals a day), AC & Electricity, a storage space, and a washing machine. I highly recommend staying here.

So, I stayed in this PG from July to November '22. To start off, the owner is highly professional in his conduct and ever present to resolve any issues that might arise. The whole PG is very well maintained to a high standard (It gives you a feel of a hotel room). They have an in-house caretaker/cook who takes care of the PG and prepares meals. The meals themselves are nutritious and tasty. The owner takes care to ensure that the community residing in the PG are all sound characters who live in harmony. Essential services like pick-and-drop laundry are available for cheap prices nearby. The PG is near the main road and transport options like auto are available. The lane for entering into the PG might seem off-putting, but as they say 'You shouldn't judge a book by it's cover'. The warm hospitality and homely feel provided by the PG more than compensate for it.

Overall, my stay here was very pleasant and I'd recommend it for any working professional who is looking for a value-for-money accommodation.
